title: LoCaR: Localized Canvas Retrieval With Frozen Vision-Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.22131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whole image embeddings can under represent small objects and local attributes that distinguish relevant images for localized queries. We present LoCaR, a training free framework for localized text to image retrieval with frozen vision language models. LoCaR constructs and utilizes independent proposals (SAM2) focusing on the object so as to get a more localized representation that independently encodes each region using the frozen visual encoder. We further study paired-support adaptation as an optional residual that uses matched text region exemplars without updating the underlying encoders. We also introduce LOCFG, a Visual Genome derived benchmark designed to evaluate localized retrieval for smaller and more challenging referents. Across several vision language backbones, our results show that improving the region representation itself is the main source of gain.

translated_title: LoCaR：基于冻结视觉-语言模型的局部画布检索
translated_abstract: 整幅图像的嵌入表示可能无法充分表征那些在局部查询中用于区分相关图像的小物体和局部属性。我们提出了 LoCaR，这是一个无需训练的框架，用于在冻结的视觉-语言模型上进行局部化的文本到图像检索。LoCaR 构建并利用聚焦于目标的独立候选区域（SAM2），通过冻结的视觉编码器对每个区域进行独立编码，从而获得更局部化的表示。我们进一步研究了配对支持适配，作为一种可选的残差方法，它利用匹配的文本-区域示例而无需更新底层编码器。我们还引入了 LOCFG，这是一个源自 Visual Genome 的基准数据集，旨在评估针对更小、更具挑战性指代对象的局部化检索。在多个视觉-语言骨干网络上的结果表明，改进区域表示本身是性能提升的主要来源。
tldr: LoCaR 是一个无需训练的局部化文本到图像检索框架，利用 SAM2 生成的目标候选区域和冻结视觉编码器对每个区域独立编码，从而有效提升对小物体和局部属性的检索能力，并引入 LOCFG 基准数据集进行评估。
en_tdlr: LoCaR is a training-free localized text-to-image retrieval framework that leverages SAM2 object proposals with a frozen vision encoder to independently encode each region, improving retrieval of small objects and local attributes, and is evaluated on the new LOCFG benchmark derived from Visual Genome.
